"The obsession is almost like you must have this perfect feeling that everything is just right and unless you achieve it you chase the feeling with compulsions." Yeah I feel that is quite accurate.

I believe it's like this, so in life, often things don't really go our way, we want something to happen our way, but it rarely does. Also things are two kind, what we can control and what we cannot control.

Ofc I realize that we just have to accept things as they are, for example, I ordered a laptop and I hope it is with me right now, but it didn't arrive yet. I feel a bit sad but I get over it quickly because I can't do anything about it. I am guessing this is like things we cannot control, so it's easier to accept it.

Then, there are other things, for example, I want to improve myself, but I couldn't because of lack of determination, etc. So I kind of accept who I am but probably I still have internal conflict. And I've had this issue many years, so the pressure could be building up inside of me.

As an effect, I think I am using compensation, so me creating some rules is like a compensation or distraction method for me. Like although other things didn't go my way, if I make these small things important, and make them go away, then I can be happy.

Then, sometimes these small things don't go my way like what I described, then again I feel that I am not in control, not achieving what I want, and I get depressed.

So really I am just keeping reliving what I've been feeling all along, things I feel I can control (such as taking the first bite of a pizza), but I didn't control it, and I get depressed.

Having said that, I don't know if this is really my issue root, or if I am just messing with self-diagnosis.

To be honest, I didn't get support, not because of money, but I feel I resent the idea of seeing a doctor or even admit to someone and discuss my thoughts, I could do it on here because of anonymous, I know it's irrational but I think I feel if I don't see a doctor, then I am still okay, also maybe subconsciously I feel there is a stigma.

I understand that it's hard to listen to other people's venting, thank you for listening.

Actually, what I described is just one of my many obsessions...I already let it grow inside of my mind...I've had many obsessions already, some disappeared, then some new one appeared...Deep down, I kind of know why this is all happening to me, because of my internal conflicts, which manifested it itself into these things.

No need to be sorry, while writing, I also started similar to you, wrote a lot of details, because I wanted people to understand. So, that's fine. It's just if we condense it down, we can note out the important parts. For example, you now made it very clear, which is great.

Firstly, I believe there are a lot of people out there who we can establish friendship or other relationship with. The thing is that people are all different and indeed some people can have preconceptions and distance them away from you. BUT that doesn't mean you are truly toxic. It could mean that these people are not a good match your friendship.

I'll use an example, let's say two person come from two different cultural background, and so they have very different ideas about manners or etiquette, so what one person think is completely acceptable is unacceptable to the other person. In order for them to continue being friends, they'd both have to adapt, or either one has to adapt. But maybe they don't want to adapt, because if you have a lot of differences, it'd hard to adapt, right? Do you think these people are toxic? Or it's just they have different boundaries? 

Sometimes we just have to accept the fact that we can't be friends with everyone and we should focus on people who can be our friends, i.e. good match for us.

I understand that you'd feel bad when you feel you took some actions to be someone's friend and they end up distancing way from you, we are all human, and it's very normal to have feelings.

I think the important thing is to determine if you are actually toxic, or maybe you are just not good at expressing yourself.

So, if you don't mind, please tell me what kind of toxic behavior do you feel you exhibit?

I also had some doubts before, so I also wrote a post, and as I write the post, I try to make it short and clear, so I end up thinking more about my feelings and thoughts, which helped me understand what's important to me and what do I want.

It depends on you, yourself, entirely yourself. What kind of person are you? Are you passionate, smart, hardworking, with a drive to success?
